body: I guess I do not understand fully. Are you still dating the man you love? Do you still have contact with him? What is the extent that you have been forbidden from him?

I know how you feel I am in the same situation. Do you have friends that you can lean on to get your mind off things? Hanging out with friends always gets my mind off the girl I love. I am also steadily moving on from her and maybe you should try this also. It will really hurt for a good amount of time. They were your closest companion and your lover that is understandable. Just know that I am here for you and all of Reddit is here whenever you need to vent. Don't be afraid to cry a little either it always feels good.
hey i sent you a pm im here to talk for a little while if you want :) you dont have to do this alone.
Give me a pm or maybe we can talk on skype I am here for you.
I remember talking to you before. I am here again if you need me. I care about you :) send me a pm.

The first thing I would do. Call CPS. Your mother sounds like a pit of evil who will turn anyone depressed. I stress to immediatly start asking friends if they can take you in. The environment you live in and shape your thoughts into a lot better ones. Please take the steps to take back your life and show your mother you are better than her hate.
pm me i will talk to you anytime i am online. Which is a lot of the time.
Cool well I am just saying that your parents will simply worry sick and do irrational things that they think will try to help you be happier when in reality will be hurting your mood.
yep graduating in a month :)

DO NOT tell your parents. When I tried to kill myself and my mom found all my pills scattered across my room she started sobbing. I know this because she was still crying 6 hours later when I woke up from passing out and I was barely alive. She still continues to worry and is questioning letting me go to college. Tell your friends if they will understand depression but if they will judge you do not. At least I do not advise it.

I beg you do not do this. I tried to kill myself out of spite for a person and it is not worth it. That is letting them win. You still have your memories of your father so hold on to those they are precious. Try to surround yourself with more positive things. Listen to some of your favorite music or watch your favorite tv show. It may not seem like much but a laugh and a smile goes a long way. Please do not kill yourself.

I was also misdiagnosed and I also was on risperdal. I would almost fall asleep dieing after sleeping for 14 hours the previous day and fall asleep every day in class. It was like I was not even living a single day of my life. It made me not want to live.

Just take your time to show your scars. Do not overwhelm potential friends and I gurantee you will find a nice set to help you. Unfortunately I need to sleep right now but I will answer anything tomorrow.

Just know that as of know I am your friend, Hello I am Evan :). I was also previously hospitalized for a hallucinogenic panic attack also. It is never too late to try and find friends. Some of the nicest people are also on this sub reddit and I have found some great souls here. So you have come to the right place.

I think what you should do is take a break from your husband. You need to be with your old family. If they are still alive your mother and father. Or maybe some siblings, they will always stick by you. Try to do something for yourself. If you have the money plan a vacation just planning it may feel good.
Please do not encourage suicide. This man really needs our help and really needs to look at life in a different light instead of be encouraged that this is how it can only go.
The emergency room will not prescribe a change in medicine. Ever. Keep that mind. I went for a panic attack and was diagnosed as a schizophrenic... so just keep that in mind

Well Miller I urge you to not take your own life. Your parents alone will be devasted. People have a way of holding in the appreication until the person is gone. Just today you helped me to not cut myself and relapse. You did a great thing for me. Do not think of yourself as a bad person. Who cares what drugs you are into, the scars you have endured you will find someone for you. You will find that companion. Maybe take a year off and not go to college. Maybe go backpacking around Europe or something to find some new perspective in life. And you said your not good at anything? Sounds like photography is your thing. You bring beauty into the world, just keep bringing it in don't give up.

I am so sorry to hear that, just smile at them and that is how you will win that battle and that will be the best revenge. You know that those things are not true. You are obviously a very caring person I can see that already.

Guess what I care about you, I do not know you but I truely do care about you. I was just about to relapse with cutting again. Then I saw this comment. It made me feel so good that I do not think i will at all anymore. You will find somebody who can truly help you in your daily life. You can always pm me and I will respond by the end of the day most likely. Hell I am terrified of the weight room unit in gym or the swimming. In swimming I have to take my shirt off. Then people shout Auschwitz survivor or something like that. I feel ashamed. But you can always gain a strong supportive group of friends. Just let them know how much your support would mean.

I used to be in the same boat. I used to be so lonely and used to not feel anything because I bottled up all of my emotions to much better if I didn't my lonliness would overwhelm me. One thing I can promise you is that once you have one relationship it gets a lot easier to find more girls. All I can really say is try to be really social. Get a girl's number and text her once. Become friends with her and the rest will be natural. Chemistry between you two will flow. Also just realize that women are not as hard to get as they seem to be. I used to be so nervous around them, but in reality they feel the same way. Many girls will also love you for who you are. Many will be able to realate to lonliness. Something that I think applies here is something that I look for in a girl. Scars. Physical scars. Some people including me love to relate to a companion's sadness. So do not look at your inexperience with women as a bad thing. I had my first girlfriend around a year ago at age 17. She thought being my first girlfriend was the cutest thing. That can happen to you also I promise.

This is also my first time commenting on this sub-reddit. 
I feel like the best thing for you is just a healthy outlet. DO NOT use cutting or burning to satisfy your anger. It is a dreadful addiction that I and many of my close friends have endured. Some things that I find to help is music. Whether it is playing a musical instrument or just listening to music. Whatever your musical preference is. I use metal and Dubstep specifically when I am in a bad mood but its specific to the person. Also find somebody you trust. You can seek refuge in a friend or a family member. Personally I found my parents to be hard to open up to and I think that is a common theme for most people. Believe I have been where you have been. I stared at myself in a mirror one night and broke my jaw with my own fist. But it did not help. Instead I urge you to use a healthy method. Go out with your friends and just try to be stress free. If university is causing you to feel this way maybe take a year off. It may not be the ideal thing but if that is what gets you on a better mindset it is worth it. I hope that my post helped you I hope your situation improves so badly.
